purpose: Define reusable complications, escalations, reversals and twists from color/inconvenience through crisis, including derailment-recovery structures, without forcing outcomes, choices, hidden authorial corrections, live-state mutations or difficulty conclusions.
controlling_rule: A GCL-06 record introduces or reframes a bounded change that can complicate play while preserving player agency and multiple continuations. It does not declare what actually happens, invalidate an unexpected player choice, fabricate hidden facts, mutate live state, or convert descriptive pressure into a difficulty score.

nonauthorization: does not create or mutate Campaign/Scene/Encounter live state
does not force a player choice or required solution
does not declare a canonical reversal, reveal, consequence or outcome
does not invent hidden information beyond authorized context
does not tune difficulty or collapse pressure into a scalar
does not award rewards or mutate aftermath/world state
does not invalidate unexpected player choices to restore prepared material

stable_id_rule: complication_template_id must begin with the manifest-declared family prefix and remain stable across wording-only revisions.
parameterization_rule: All {slot_id} placeholders in a compact GCL-06 record must be declared in slot_ids and come from the controlled slot vocabulary.

slot_vocabulary.semantic_role: person, object, place, process, state or bounded goal at issue
person/group/object whose safety, access or continued function may matter
explicit deadline, countdown, schedule, depletion or event boundary
deliberately unresolved fact/question
bounded occurrence or transition
clue, trace, record, testimony or observable support
group/side/coalition later bound by the consumer
competing or obstructing actor/group/process, not automatically hostile
decision maker, gatekeeper, office or institution
governed place, zone or destination
path, passage, itinerary or movement option
scarce, carried, consumed, contested or useful asset
governed danger or environmental/system pressure
barrier, constraint, access problem or bounded obstruction supplied by owning context
device, mechanism, structure, vehicle or technical object
settlement, crew, household, organization or social group
trust, obligation, rivalry, debt or social bond supplied by owning context
person/source able to provide partial information
organized interest/group/institution reference
explicitly open benefit, route, leverage, aid or alternative that may be pursued but is not guaranteed
established prior event or unresolved prior thread
third party with an independent interest and no presumed alignment

pressure_reference_rule: pressure_dimensions is descriptive metadata identifying PPIA-11/F012 dimensions a reusable complication may touch. It encodes no magnitude, weight, easier/harder direction, target band or guarantee; GCL-07 owns later difficulty-shaping advice.
severity_rule: severity_band is a narrative/operational scope label only—color, inconvenience, pressure, setback or crisis. It is not a universal difficulty score and may not be mapped to one without an owning-domain method.
derailment_recovery_rule: Recovery templates treat unexpected player choices as valid input. They may rebind, defer or repurpose compatible prepared material, but may not invalidate the choice, secretly restore the old branch, fabricate a mandatory correction, or close all alternate continuations.
information_rule: Reveal and assumption-reversal templates may only operate on authorized evidence, established facts and explicitly unresolved unknowns. GCL-06 does not grant hidden-information access or retroactively rewrite established facts.

outcome_openness.rule: Complications expose change, escalation, reversal, response, opportunity and continuation structures while leaving actual events and resolution to authorized live play.

f005_boundary: MV-IA-F005 and related Campaign/Scene/Session authorities own placement, live state, accepted history, reveals and session progression.
f012_boundary: MV-IA-F012 owns actual Encounter drafts, objective bindings, participants, analysis, approval and live encounter structure.
gcl07_boundary: GCL-07 owns later pressure/difficulty shaping; GCL-06 may name descriptive pressure dimensions only.
gcl14_boundary: GCL-14 owns reward, aftermath and consequence libraries; consequence_echo here only offers reusable complication framing and cannot mutate aftermath.
composition_rule: GCL-06 composes with GCL-02 hooks, GCL-03 situations, GCL-04 encounters, GCL-05 objectives and later GCL-07/09/10/14 structures. All output remains proposal material until accepted by an owning domain.
